question: What is the title of Sania Mirza's autobiography?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ace Against Odds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ace Against Odds** is the autobiography of Indian tennis star **Sania Mirza**.
 
• The book was published in **July 2016** and provides insights into her life and career.
 
• It was co-written by **Sania Mirza** and her father **Imran Mirza**.
 
• The autobiography chronicles her journey as a professional tennis player, including **her struggles, achievements, and personal experiences**.
 
• Sania Mirza is regarded as one of India’s most successful and influential athletes, with multiple Grand Slam titles to her name.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autobiography:** An autobiography is a self-written account of the author's life, often highlighting personal experiences and key milestones.
 
• **Sania Mirza:** Sania Mirza is an Indian professional tennis player who has been ranked as India’s No. 1 player in both singles and doubles.
 
• **Grand Slam Titles:** Sania Mirza has won six Grand Slam titles in her career, including doubles and mixed doubles categories.
 
• **Ace Against Odds:** The title reflects her journey of overcoming numerous challenges to achieve success in a sport where Indians traditionally faced limited representation.
 
• **Tennis in India:** Tennis is considered a niche sport in India, and Sania's achievements have been instrumental in popularizing it, especially among women.
